_about: LocalBit's measurement recipe - the same method its RTX 3090 node uses, so community results line up. Run it with localbit_test.py (or any tool that follows it), then submit with submit_result / POST /api/submit.

settings.think: false when the model supports thinking

tests.name: gen
tests.prompt: Write a calm, detailed story of about four hundred words about a lighthouse keeper named Imra who repairs an old clockwork lamp during a winter storm. Describe each step of the repair.
tests.measure: gen_tps = eval_count / (eval_duration in seconds); the middle of the 3 runs counts

tests.name: prompt_4k
tests.prompt_repeat: The tide charts in the lower office list every harbour light along the coast, with notes on lens type, oil supply, and the hour each lamp was last cleaned.
tests.suffix: Summarise the notes above in one sentence.

also_record: model tag as Ollama names it
graphics card or Mac name and its memory in GB
whether the model sat fully on the card (/api/ps size_vram >= size)
never_send: names, usernames, file paths, IP addresses, hostnames, serial numbers
submit: POST /api/submit (JSON, see /docs) or the MCP tool submit_result
